release: Settings Save Contention Recovery & Reliability Telemetry
name: Settings Save Contention Recovery & Reliability Telemetry
changes: Adds a settings.json-specific bounded retry window for transient Windows replace contention (WinError 5/32/33) while leaving all other atomic state writers on their existing single-attempt behavior.

Serializes settings.json replacement attempts inside the backend and retries only the final atomic replace for up to 3 seconds; the already-written temporary file is reused and the existing settings file remains intact until replacement succeeds.
Adds passive settings_save_reliability diagnostics counters for attempts, successful saves, recovered retries, retry attempts, terminal failures, last elapsed time, and last WinError.

Preserves browsing telemetry schema 7, the accepted All Posts two-batch/3-second render accumulator, six-slot Video ceiling, five-request Image HTTP gate, provider allocation, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Settings retry is limited to WinError 5/32/33 and a 3.0-second bounded window; unrelated OSErrors are not retried.
Only settings.json opts into replace retry; json_write/json_write_compact retain the established default single-attempt atomic writer behavior.
settings_save_reliability diagnostics expose recovered retries and terminal failures without recording user settings content.
Browsing schema remains 7; All Posts accumulator, Video six-slot ceiling, Image gate 5, 800/800/1000 headers, SABnzbd 5.1.2, and terminal-history schema 3 remain unchanged.
release_name: Settings Save Contention Recovery & Reliability Telemetry
